prompt: What is the key structural difference between a prokaryotic and a eukaryotic cell?
options: Prokaryotic cells have no cell membrane
explanation: Prokaryotic cells (bacteria) have no nucleus — DNA floats free as a single loop.

prompt: Name one structure found in plant cells but not animal cells.
explanation: Any of: cell wall, chloroplasts, permanent vacuole.

prompt: An image of a cell is 8 mm wide. The magnification used was ×400. Find the actual size in μm.
A cell is actually 25 μm wide. At ×200 magnification, how wide will the image be, in mm?
A potato chip has an initial mass of 5.2 g. After soaking in a salt solution, its mass is 4.8 g. Find the percentage change in mass, to 2 d.p.
workedSolution: % change = (4.8 − 5.2) ÷ 5.2 × 100 = −7.69% — the chip lost water, so the solution was more concentrated than the cells.

prompt: Which transport process requires energy from respiration?
explanation: Active transport moves particles against the concentration gradient, which needs energy.

prompt: Put these steps in order for using a light microscope to observe a specimen.
items: Place the slide on the stage and select the lowest-power objective lens
Use the coarse focus to bring the image roughly into focus
Switch to a higher-power objective lens and use the fine focus
Draw the specimen and record the magnification used

prompt: Root hair cells absorb mineral ions from the soil, even when the concentration of those ions is higher inside the root hair cell than in the soil. Explain how this happens.
indicativeContent: This is movement against the concentration gradient (low to high), so diffusion cannot explain it
This requires active transport, which uses energy
The energy comes from respiration happening in the root hair cell's mitochondria
Root hair cells have a large surface area (from their hair-like shape) and many mitochondria, both suited to this function
A full-marks answer names active transport specifically and explains why diffusion alone can't work here

levelDescriptors.description: States active transport is involved, with little explanation.
